tool_args.rationale: The added rows provide varied normalized before/after contrasts across horizons, supporting a fitted low-dimensional contrast-plus-horizon interaction. The code estimates all coefficients by least squares and predicts from the fitted parameters; nuisance auxiliary measurements are not relevant.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The available observations already span eight varied before/after contrasts and horizons; a low-dimensional normalized-hysteresis model can be fit numerically, while no remaining discriminating probe is listed.

The authorized form depends on the raw step and exponential horizon decay; the observed target is explicitly scoped to normalized before/after hysteresis and includes a nonzero equal-input response, inconsistent with that form.
The pilot signature says static snapshots are uninformative, and the opposing-step responses depend on the before/after contrast.
